description: Couple the block-FP8 drafted fixture's MTP drafts to the target sampler's noise (runtime.mtp_coupled_drafts). Each rank loads the unchanged locked draft noise module, resolves its one entry and allocates its noise records. The drafted step's extend and draft step graphs each capture one more node, the draft noise launch, so their creators are declared removed and added. Exact operation edits add each drafter run's record uploads and the draft noise launch before each argmax partial; every retained operation is compared under the ordered handle map.
